fishing: WHEN: Sunday Oct 4. Port Boca Grande high 6:00a (2.0 ft), low 3:18p (0.2 ft). Lemon Bay sunrise 7:23a / sunset 7:12p; solunar coefficient 44 (low). Best windows dawn and the evening move before the cells. SE 10 kt becoming SW, light chop, 38% storms after 2p, air ~90F. Snook harvest open in Charlotte Harbor / SW through Nov 30 (slot 28-33, 1/day). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 has redfish and snook on shoreline edges of the trough; ladyfish, bluefish and trout mixed in, not a hot surf day. Stump Pass islands still the earlier hold; Spanish were just outside the pass. Manasota first light remains the snook window (Joe Sheaffer, early Oct, glass minnows and a ladyfish bait). LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and a few snook; trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: fall mix — mangrove snapper inside 20 miles, permit and cobia on wrecks, Spanish around bait; gag grouper season open. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, white bait, gold spoons, topwater.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (three Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach and Stump Pass. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/4). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU, no advisory.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 customers out this morning; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
